name: Jehudi
overview: Jehudi, identified as a Jew and an official in King Jehoiakim's court, played a pivotal role in the events surrounding the prophet Jeremiah's scroll. According to Jeremiah 36, Jehudi was sent by the princes to retrieve the scroll from Baruch and then read it aloud to the king and his princes, demonstrating his trusted position in the royal administration. However, after reading several leaves, Jehudi actively cut and cast the scroll into the fire, illustrating the rejection of God's prophetic message by the king's court.
